stories.alt: Diwali greeting card from human skills.in reading Happy Diwali, with hanging lanterns, a golden frame around the human skills.in logo, an open book and six lit diyas on a teal rangoli.

Diwali greeting card from human skills.in showing a family exchanging sweets in a lamp-lit courtyard with fireworks overhead, rows of diyas and a flower rangoli, captioned May your life be illuminated with connection and knowledge.

Diwali greeting card from human skills.in showing Lord Rama, Sita and Lakshmana walking through a lamp-lit Ayodhya as crowds hold diyas, captioned May the inner lamp of your potential and skill be ignited.
Diwali greeting card from human skills.in showing Lord Rama, Sita and Lakshmana on a flower-decked chariot before a crowd holding diyas, captioned Human Skills.in wishes you a blessed Diwali.
